cases.text:
Unfortunately, once an order has shipped, we're no longer able to make address changes on our end. Per our [Shipping Policy (kb/02-shipping-policy.md)](kb/02-shipping-policy.md), address changes are only possible **before** the order ships. After shipment, you'll need to **contact the carrier directly** to request a delivery address update.

Here are a few tips for reaching out to the carrier:
- You'll find the **carrier name and tracking number** in your shipping confirmation email.
- Most major carriers (UPS, FedEx, USPS) offer address update or package intercept options through their websites or customer service lines — sometimes for a small fee.

If you need help finding your tracking number, feel free to share your order number and I can look it up for you!
